create.title: Connect an assistant
create.name: Name
create.nameHint: Helps you tell connections apart. For example: Claude on my laptop.
create.readHint: It can see your targets, days, foods and saved meals. It cannot change anything.
create.writeHint: It can also log and plan entries, add foods and saved meals, and change your targets. It cannot delete your foods or saved meals.
create.readOnlyLine: Read only. The assistant can see your targets, days, foods and saved meals. It cannot change anything.
create.writeExpiryHint: A key that can make changes lasts at most 90 days.

consentRead.reads: The assistant can read your targets, every day you logged or planned, your foods and your saved meals.
consentRead.vendor: What you ask it and what it reads go to the company that runs the assistant. Their terms apply to that data.
consentRead.barcodes: Barcodes it looks up count toward the same hourly limit as your own scans.
consentRead.secret: Anyone who has the key can read all of this until the key expires or you revoke it. Keep it private.
consentRead.answers: The assistant's answers are its own. They can be wrong, and they are not nutrition or medical advice.
consentRead.agree: I understand and I want to connect.

consentWrite.reads: The assistant can read your targets, every day you logged or planned, your foods and your saved meals.
consentWrite.changes: It can log, plan, change, move, copy and remove entries, add and change your foods and saved meals, and change your targets. It cannot delete your foods or saved meals.
consentWrite.asks: Hovimestari tells your assistant to ask you before each change. Hovimestari cannot make it ask, so look over what it did.
consentWrite.recorded: Every change it makes is recorded under this connection's name. You can read them here under Activity.
consentWrite.vendor: What you ask it and what it reads go to the company that runs the assistant. Their terms apply to that data.
consentWrite.barcodes: Barcodes it looks up count toward the same hourly limit as your own scans.
consentWrite.secret: Anyone who has the key can read and change all of this until the key expires or you revoke it. Revoking it stops it at once. Keep it private.
consentWrite.answers: The assistant's answers are its own. They can be wrong, and they are not nutrition or medical advice.
consentWrite.agree: I understand it can change my data, and I want to connect.

reveal.lost: If you lose the key before you use it, revoke this connection and connect again. That makes a new key.

setup.heading: Set up your assistant
setup.claudeCodeHint: Add --scope user to use it in every project.
setup.claudeDesktopStep: In Claude, open Settings, then Developer, then Edit Config. Add this to the file. If the file already has mcpServers, put the entry inside it. Save and restart Claude. It needs Node.js on your computer.
